name: Support Agent Returned Wrong Refund Policy
description: A customer support RAG agent gave outdated refund policy guidance after a docs deployment and stale vector index.

events.title: Refund policy docs updated
events.details: The public refund policy changed from 30 days to 14 days.

events.title: Embedding refresh failed
events.details: The document update was not embedded because the worker hit a rate limit.

events.title: Stale refund policy chunk retrieved
events.details: Top retrieved chunk still says customers can request refunds within 30 days.

events.title: Model generated outdated policy answer
events.details: The assistant told the customer the refund window is 30 days.

events.title: Customer marked answer incorrect
events.details: The customer cited the new 14-day policy page.

events.title: Refund policy eval failed
events.details: Regression eval expected 14 days but received 30 days.
